reference: Wu et al. (2005), ISB recommendation Part II, J Biomech 38:981-992, doi:10.1016/j.jbiomech.2004.05.042
interpretation: ISB-style intrinsic YXY decomposition with explicit proxy axes; NOT validated ISB anatomical calibration
axes: Right-handed columns X anterior, Y superior, Z right
sequence: R_template=Ry(plane) Rx(-elevation) Ry(axial); intrinsic YXY, negative middle branch
sides: Right template; left reflected with S R_left S, S=diag(1,1,-1). Bilateral standardized signs, not an unlabelled native left Euler sequence.
signs: Plane 0=coronal abduction, +90=forward flexion; elevation positive arm raising; axial positive internal rotation in the right-template/left-mirrored construction
threshold_note: Conditioning threshold chosen for inspection, NOT a statistical confidence bound

thorax.method: Neutral Hips->Chest superior, hip-center right direction orthogonalized; anterior cross product checked against eye/head direction. Missing IJ/C7/PX/T8.

left.transverse_axis: Thorax anterior projected perpendicular to neutral humerus long axis; assumed twist, NOT epicondylar calibration

right.transverse_axis: Thorax anterior projected perpendicular to neutral humerus long axis; assumed twist, NOT epicondylar calibration

left.interpretation: Clip excursion under unvalidated proxy calibration; not clinical maximum ROM. Plane/axial statistics use one contiguous valid interval only.

right.interpretation: Clip excursion under unvalidated proxy calibration; not clinical maximum ROM. Plane/axial statistics use one contiguous valid interval only.

limitations: No verified medial/lateral epicondyles or functional GH center
Humerus axial zero is assumed from neutral model anterior, not measured
No frame-zero angle subtraction; no smoothing or forced motion fit
Plane and axial unstable near arm down/up, separated from elevation
Proxy calibration and video accuracy unvalidated; axes consistency is not anatomy accuracy
